summary: Antelope Enterprise Holdings Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of a $3,000,000 convertible promissory note to Stratosphere Capital Management Inc., an accredited investor. The note is convertible into up to 4,800,000 Class A ordinary shares. No placement agent is involved, and the note is not listed on any exchange. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The company has a public float of $10.1M and limits sales under General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3. There is no board recommendation or deal structure beyond the convertible note terms.
